assets.label: Halle ouverte du marché
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG building sprite for a detailed 2.5D Yautja Homeworld game.
Create exactly ONE full-size open CLAN MARKET HALL, EMPTY of loose merchandise, inhabitants and stalls. A complete long building, 18 metres wide, 10 metres deep, 8 metres tall; widely spaced substantial pillars, three tall open passage bays at front, entrances 3.2 metres high minimum. Long ribbed bronze canopy roof supported on monumental dark basalt piers, elevated fine roof fins, trapezoidal technology joints and restrained warm amber lamps inset in pillars. Practical hunting-clan architecture from the Predator universe: black volcanic stone, worn gunmetal, dull aged bronze, tiny worn rust-red canopy fabric accents. Heavy, ancient, alien engineering, restrained skull-free angular ornament. This is a new game adaptation, not a reproduction of a claimed movie building.
VIEW: locked orthographic projection, camera looking down 35 degrees, camera azimuth/yaw 0 degrees, front facade horizontal and upright, roof depth visible. No perspective convergence, no 45-degree isometric rotation. Full realistic architectural proportions, slender full-height doorways, no condensed cute miniature proportions.
LIGHTING: soft neutral light from upper left, readable dark materials, no fog.
COMPOSITION: wide landscape canvas. Entire single building including roof tips and all foundations centered within the middle 70 percent of the image; at least 12 percent EMPTY TRANSPARENT margin on ALL FOUR sides. Nothing may approach the border. No ground plane, no landscape or scene, no cast shadow outside foundation, no background glow.
Output genuinely transparent alpha background, crisp clean silhouette. NO lettering, NO labels, NO diagram, NO contact sheet, NO border, NO fake checkerboard, NO characters, NO animals, NO separate objects.

assets.label: Caisse marchande — état ouvert
assets.role: État ouvert complémentaire de la caisse marchande existante.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG game prop, HWM162-S08, open merchant cargo crate for Yautja: The Long Hunt. This is an original game adaptation, not a certified film prop.
INPUT IMAGE 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET: the existing closed dark metal cargo crate. Change only its open/closed state. Preserve the same identity: the charcoal metal body, weathered aged-bronze angular corner caps and rails, broad engraved front panel, recessed side carrying handle, trapezoid feet, and paired black securing straps and bronze catches. Preserve the reference's exact three-quarter viewing direction, camera projection, object proportions and upper-left lighting. Do NOT turn the crate front-on, mirror it, replace its design, recolor it or reinterpret its ornament.
Raise the ONE lid on rear hinges, around 105 degrees from its closed position, so the empty dark metal interior is clearly visible. The lid stays physically attached to the rear edge. Release the two front securing catches and straps so they do not impossibly continue across the open gap; they can remain attached at their original mounting points. Keep the body, all four feet and the side handle in the same design. The inside is one usable empty compartment, with no cargo, tray, cloth, weapons or small loose objects. No detached second lid, no second box and no separate before/after state.
Reframe only as needed so the COMPLETE open crate including raised lid, feet and every fitting is centered and entirely inside the canvas, with roughly 12 percent genuinely empty transparent space on every side. Keep the whole source body silhouette; no cuts or border contact. Preserve the realistic detailed painted game-art surface quality and original bronze/charcoal palette. Output true transparent alpha, including the open surrounding space, with no background color, checkerboard, landscape, floor slab or atmosphere. No cast shadow outside the object. No text, labels, numbers, watermark, diagram or collage. Exactly ONE complete open crate sprite.
assets.visual_review: Une seule caisse ouverte, couvercle attaché par deux charnières, compartiment vide visible, deux fermoirs frontaux libérés, poignée latérale et pieds conservés. Identité bronze/charbon, motifs et vue diagonale de la référence reconnaissables. Aucun second objet, texte lisible ou coupe de silhouette observé. La géométrie de l’état ouvert n’est pas certifiée identique au pixel près à l’état fermé ; pivot et raccord à vérifier en scène.
